title: Death toll in Spain train crash rises to at least 30, with rescue and recovery operations ongoing
summary: Two high speed trains carrying hundreds of passengers collided in central Spain south of Madrid. Officials warn that the death toll is likely to increase. Follow DW

image.caption: At least two train carriages derailed and tumbled down an embankmentImage: Juanma Jiménez/EUROPA PRESS/dpa/picture alliance
